title: job
description: Manage a durable process. Operations: start, read (incremental output by cursor), input (PTY input), signal, stop, status. Long-running processes (servers, watchers, test runners that exceed exec timeout) use job instead of exec.

job_id.description: Required for read, input, signal, stop, status operations.

argv.description: Required for start. Structured argv; first element is executable.

cursor.description: For read: return output chunks since this cursor.

input.description: For input: text to send to the PTY.

signal.description: For signal: the signal to send.
